# Rufus Vane

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v4 c6 P21](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0021)</sub>
- **Status:** deceased  <sub>[v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015), [v4 c31 P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Seven Gulls (or the Glen area), St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>
- **Role:** sawmill operator, clerk, and sailor  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Rufus was a large, handsome man with a high color, a small, wicked soul, and an unusual physical trait: one hazel eye and one blue. His cousin Laurence Vane resembled him so closely in height, build, and facial features that locals easily mistook Laurence for Rufus when Laurence returned from Cuba with memory loss.

_Sources: [v4 c9 P14](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0014), [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P32](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0032)_

## Personality

Rufus was a selfish, persistent, and bad-tempered man who drank heavily and continually pursued his own desires until he obtained them, only to lose interest afterward. He used financial pressure against his future mother-in-law to force Lorna Ainslie to marry him. He possessed a sailor's nautical inclination and quickly grew restless with quiet domestic life.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028)_

- sailing  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>

## Goals

- marry Lorna Ainslie by forcing her mother's hand through mortgage foreclosure threats  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027)</sub>

## History

Rufus Vane operated a small sawmill up river and married Mrs. Rudge, with whom he had eight children, including three consecutive sets of twins. After his death, his household was dissolved. In Seven Gulls, he worked as a clerk in his father's store during the winter and sailed during the summer. Restless and persistent, he pursued Lorna Ainslie and forced her into marriage by threatening to foreclose on her widowed mother's farm mortgage. Shortly after her mother died, Rufus grew tired of domestic life and sailed for Havana aboard the Four Sisters alongside his cousin Laurence Vane. Rufus contracted yellow fever and died in Cuba thirteen years before the truth was revealed. Because Laurence suffered head trauma and amnesia in Havana, Captain Saul Garrick mistakenly brought Laurence back to Seven Gulls, where Lorna and the community believed the brain-damaged cousin was Rufus for eleven years until an operation in Montreal restored Laurence's memory.

_Sources: [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015), [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 c11 P31](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0031), [v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 c31 P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028), [v4 c32 P15](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0015)_

## Background by volume

- Son of Abner Vane, a storekeeper at the Glen  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027)</sub>
- Formerly married to Mrs. Rudge and fathered eight children, including three consecutive sets of twins  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Operated a small sawmill in a clearing up river before passing away  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
- Married Lorna Ainslie after leveraging his father's mortgage on her family farm  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027)</sub>
